estimator: L2 logistic regression C=1 class_weight=balanced lbfgs max_iter=5000, fixed without model comparison
baseline: training-fold class frequency prior; additional known-evidence-only baseline for indicator and tool tasks
encoding: binary multihot DictVectorizer, fit on training fold only; unknown test category ignored
validation: 10 repeated StratifiedGroupKFold, seed20261029+repeat, at most5 folds, all rows of paper stay together
support: at least5 records from3 papers per target class; task requires30 records and2 classes; support filter applied to full corpus to define estimand
scoring: pooled out-of-fold predictions per repeat; macroF1 explicitly includes all retained target labels; no averaging over variable class sets across folds
weighting: primary metrics record-weighted; sensitivity metrics weight each paper equally by inverse record count; training not paper weighted
uncertainty: split SD/range only; no confidence intervals, p values, or normalized importance weights
limitations: retrospective coding is not independently blinded
G5 uses earlier identity-based taxonomy rather than latest role taxonomy
grouped CV does not eliminate publication or missing reporting bias
known dimension/indicator assumes these are supplied by the user and is not an end-to-end prediction result
tool instances can include multiple classes per chain; estimates are instance-level, not joint multitool recommendations
no prospective user evaluation or calibration guarantee
